title: Remove hotcrm submodule
body:
Remove the `examples/hotcrm` git submodule and all supporting infrastructure.

### Deleted
- `.gitmodules`, `examples/hotcrm` submodule
- `examples/hotcrm-bridge.js` / `.d.ts` — dynamic import bridge for hotcrm plugins
- `examples/hotcrm-stubs/ai.ts` — `@hotcrm/ai` stub

### Cleaned references
- `pnpm-workspace.yaml` — removed hotcrm workspace globs
- `apps/console/objectstack.shared.ts` — removed `hotcrmObjects`/`hotcrmApps` merge logic
- `apps/console/vite.config.ts` — removed `@hotcrm/ai` resolve alias
- `objectstack.config.ts` — removed hotcrm comments
- `ROADMAP_CONSOLE.md` — removed hotcrm mention

Console now builds with only the built-in examples (CRM, Todo, Kitchen Sink). All 5070 tests pass.
